## About
Middlesex Truck & Coach works on trucks, buses and equipment out of Gerard Street in Boston. We handle vehicle needs in house, which keeps your downtime and sublet costs down.
Collision, frame and suspension, fabrication, body and trailer components. If it has to do with heavy equipment, we can help. Customers rate us 4.4 on Google from 44 reviews.

## Services
- Comprehensive Collision Repair: From a bent bumper to a wreck.
- Complete Vehicle Rehabilitation: The entire vehicle brought back, handled in house.
- Custom Fabrication: Built to suit your company's particular application.
- Full Line Equipment Distributor: Equipment for trucks, buses and heavy equipment, custom built to suit your company's particular application.
- Entire Line Body/Trailer Components: Body and trailer parts. One reviewer called us the best place for parts in the city.
- Claim settlement help: Licensed and experienced people who work hard to get you the proper claim settlement.

## FAQ
Q: Can I drop off or pick up after hours?
A: Yes. Vehicle receiving and pick up are open around the clock, every day of the week.

Q: Can you help with my claim?
A: Our appraisers streamline the claims process for prompt settlement and expedient repair.

Q: Need road service or a tow?
A: Call our associates: Schlagers Towing, McGraths Towing or Coadys Towing.
